assumptions.choice: Factor in commission rate (0.001) during size calculation
assumptions.reason: To strictly satisfy the requirement that after trade execution remaining cash does not drop below 50% of total portfolio value.

assumptions.choice: Use entry bar ATR (entry_atr) for evaluating 1xATR price target increase
assumptions.reason: The 1xATR target represents a fixed profit target set at position entry.

assumptions.choice: Execute roll via notify_order upon completion of the sell order when rolling flag is set
assumptions.reason: Ensures the closing sell order completes before placing the new buy order, accurately resetting the 30-bar timer upon new entry fill.
